bullets.text: As an individual contribution to a supervised capstone, wrote Python functions to parse provided news records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, validated SQL joins with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules using pandas and Matplotlib.
Ran and inspected a supplied Python notebook to load provided policy records, and edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.

Under supervision, joined document identifiers to metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; executed and inspected supplied analysis notebooks to visualize group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.
